text:
MAGA influencer Riley Gaines is facing ruthless ridicule after a new video showed her asking what her core beliefs are.

The reportedly leaked video shows Gaines asking her sponsors from the MAGA-friendly Patriot Mobile what the "pillars" are of her beliefs and counting on her fingers, as she says, "the First Amendment, the Second Amendment."

"There's virtually no sincerity left in the MAGA media ecosystem," wrote liberal writer and activist Joshua Reed Eakle. "All that remains are grifters parroting talking points that someone higher up the chain provided them, and this cycle repeats all the way down."

"This is one of the most embarrassing things I've ever seen in my life," political strategist Mike Nellis posted.

"This is nothing new," weighed in Congressman Shri Thanedar (D-MI). "This is how the entire Republican Party has been operating for 10 years, except it's Trump telling them what their 'sincerely held' beliefs are."

"Oh, good grief," reacted activist Trisha Hope.

"This is what it looks like when you sell your soul," Kyle Sweetser, a former Democratic Senate candidate, jabbed.
